data.body:
Fix pushed for review: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1478 (change 1478).

The guard now derives its candidate list from `git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard`
when the root is a git repo — exactly 'tracked, plus untracked but not ignored' — so `.gitignore`
is the single source of truth for scope and a brand-new file is still scanned the moment it is
written. The `os.walk` denylist is kept verbatim as the fallback for a non-git root (the guard's
own suite runs against throwaway tmp_path trees) and for a missing `git` binary.

Deliberately did NOT just add `.claude/` and `bridge_state/` to EXCLUDED_DIRECTORY_NAMES: the
denylist-over-an-open-filesystem shape is the defect, and it would have drifted again.

Verified against the polluted checkout that reproduces the bug (/Users/joeoakhart/rebar, which
holds .claude/worktrees/ and bridge_state/): 47,312 violations before, 0 after, exit 0.
Confirmed beforehand that all 47,312 were in gitignored paths and ZERO in git-tracked files, so
no real violation is being suppressed.

Tests were RED before the fix (3 failures) and cover: a gitignored path is ignored; a tracked
AND an untracked-but-unignored file still fail with the same path:line diagnostic; curated
exclusions (docs/archive) and allowlist count pins still hold inside a git repo; and an absent
`git` binary falls back to the walk.
